from openpyxl import load_workbook
from pathlib import Path

input_path = Path('/mnt/data/spreadsheet/50526/1_50526_input.xlsx')
output_path = Path('/mnt/data/outputs/50526_0_f921ceba/1_50526_output.xlsx')
output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb['Sheet1']

# Formula to place in B9 and drag down: returns the nth header whose value in the
# row matching lookup cell B6 is greater than 0.
base_formula = '=IFERROR(INDEX($B$1:$G$1,AGGREGATE(15,6,(COLUMN($B$1:$G$1)-COLUMN($B$1)+1)/(INDEX($B$2:$G$3,MATCH($B$6,$A$2:$A$3,0),0)>0),ROWS($B$9:{cell}))),"")'

ws['B9'] = base_formula.format(cell='B9')
ws['B10'] = base_formula.format(cell='B10')

# Ensure Excel recalculates formulas when opened.
try:
    wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True
    wb.calculation.forceFullCalc = True
    wb.calculation.calcMode = "auto"
except Exception:
    pass

wb.save(output_path)
print(f"Saved to {output_path}")
print("B9:", ws['B9'].value)
print("B10:", ws['B10'].value)
